title: Percent of customers who ordered
statementMd:
What percentage of customers have placed at least one order? Round to 1 decimal.

Expected columns: `pct`.

Tables: `customers`, `products`, `orders`, `order_items`.

Row order does not matter.
hints: Count distinct ordering customers over all customers.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM orders) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers), 1) AS pct;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
